checks.why: a key read only by @ConditionalOnProperty is a configuration fact: the beans it gates are what it reaches, with the verdict
a condition on a @Bean factory gates that factory, and nothing else in its class
a key only a condition names, defined nowhere, is still answered: the condition is undecided
control: a key bound by @Value still lists its reader
the nested YAML line that defines the key is listed, beside the flat .properties override
control: a flat dotted spelling in YAML is listed at its line, and a nested leaf of another key is not
a nested key under a parent that shares no line with it is found at the leaf, not at the parent line
